description: Repairs r-sql-13b/params-values-integers, params-values-fractional, params-values-other and params-value-readback: only 2.5 and in-length values were assigned. Asks what a declared Byte, Short, Long, Currency, IEEESingle, IEEEDouble, Bit, DateTime, Text(5) and Text(20) parameter does when assigned 2.6, 3.5, -2.5, 255.5, 300, a 10-character text and a 26-character text: per assignment the Value is read back, then PARAMETERS pX <type>; SELECT pX AS v FROM One is opened and its row and VARIANT tag read; each type is a fresh QueryDef. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
